findings.title: Same-amount matching can attach an unrelated provider refund to a local attempt
findings.detail: FIXED. refundFor now binds by provider refund ID, the dispatch attempt's own evidence, or the platform refund reference; the amount-based fallback is removed. Lines 1316–1321 record a conflicting provider refund as UNKNOWN_REFUND instead of silently discarding it. Line 1380 creates a case keyed by the provider refund identity; migration 0019_unknown_refund_cases.sql:19 includes that identity in the unique open-case subject. The regression at apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:118 checks the separate refund remains an incident while the local refund completes with its own ID, and checks another conflicting identity creates a separate case.
findings.reproduction: Checked the original AFTER_CALL webhook/settlement interleaving in b09-review.test.ts:125–173. Assertions preserve SUBMITTING after the unrelated webhook, then COMPLETED with the request's own provider ID. verify.log:666 reports this regression passed.

findings.title: A reversal observed before its completed refund double-counts returned money
findings.detail: FIXED. Refund completion reads the capture status and publishes zero returned components and zero movable balance after reversal. packages/domain/src/commerce/ledger.ts:156 defines this rule; packages/application/src/commerce/core/postings.ts:122 posts returned components rather than always posting approved amounts. The planner applies the same rule at observation.ts:538. Approved components remain available for fiscal and commission consumers. The regression at apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:226 checks three observation orders, with and without retained fees, and verifies ledger balances and return totals.
findings.reproduction: Reviewed ONE_QUERY and REVERSAL_THEN_REFUND setups at b09-review.test.ts:198–216 and the balance/return assertions at lines 233–241. They cover the original lost-response and delayed-refund reproductions. verify.log:667 reports the regression passed.

findings.title: An earlier refund prevents the watchdog from resolving a later no-effect attempt
findings.detail: FIXED. The absence loop now suppresses proof only for a matching provider refund ID or platform refund reference, rather than any refund of the same capture. Lines 774–776 retain the authoritative-view and dispatch-deadline requirements. The regression at apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:286 completes an earlier refund, then creates both a timeout without effect and a claimed-but-unsent attempt on the same capture.
findings.reproduction: Reviewed watchdog calls and durable-state assertions at b09-review.test.ts:304–322: both later refunds return to APPROVED with FAILED_NO_EFFECT attempts, the earlier refund remains COMPLETED, and no new provider refund occurs. verify.log:670 reports the regression passed.

findings.title: Provider fees learned with or after reversal are silently discarded
findings.detail: FIXED. Fee learning now runs for COMPLETED and REVERSED captures. observation.ts:1138 and packages/persistence/src/repositories/commerce-captures.ts:372 calculate zero movable balance after reversal, so the retained fee posts against the merchant's available balance. Conflicting fees remain incidents. The regression at apps/api/test/b09-review.test.ts:248 checks fees learned with a reversal query, after reversal, and through the reversal webhook, including duplicate suppression.
findings.reproduction: Reviewed persisted capture/fee-event assertions at b09-review.test.ts:253–275 and FINANCE balance assertions at lines 277–280. Each scenario preserves the 5275-cent processor expense and corresponding merchant balance debit. verify.log:669 reports the regression passed.

findings.title: Three advertised foreign-tenant denial checks use no foreign-tenant resource
findings.detail: FIXED. CMD032 now creates agency B's real refund, exercises principals without a corporate grant, and tests that an operator scope adopted through agency A cannot read, approve or adopt B's refund (lines 184–195). CMD033 creates B's approved refund at cmd033-execute-refund.test.ts:95 and checks reads, transition denial and second-scope refusal at lines 110–120. CMD034 creates B's order/query at cmd034-reconcile-payment.test.ts:95, refuses B's evidence against A's order, and checks scoped reconciler access at lines 111–129. Wrong-kind route checks remain supplemental; the evidence now includes appropriate cross-scope controls for global roles.
findings.reproduction: Traced the foreign fixtures and adopted-scope helpers, including payment-support.ts:486 using the payment service's commerce unit of work. Assertions verify the foreign records remain unchanged. verify.log:787, :791 and :794 report all three revised DENY tests passed.
